verdict.rationale: First-party docs show in-platform streaming and incremental processing. Structured Streaming expresses streaming computation like batch, supports Delta tables as sources and sinks with exactly-once guarantees, and reaches latency as low as 5 ms. Auto Loader incrementally processes new files as they arrive, and Lakeflow pipelines build and deploy ETL pipelines inside the workspace. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming and pipeline use, and in-depth evidence on how declarative pipelines behave beyond a getting-started mention.
